$ orion-node doctor

--- notes
NOTE A checklist that fills in: Grouped by where things break: Node, Core, Logs, System. One line per check with the live item shown by a spinner.
NOTE Problems explain themselves: A warning or failure expands inline: what it means, the evidence, and the exact fix in bold, ready to copy.
NOTE Calm when healthy: All passing collapses to a single line. Detail is a flag away.
NOTE Real exit codes: 0 healthy, 1 problems found. --json keeps the per-check schema.
NOTE New check: Log source and ingest key check does not exist yet; this board assumes it.
